newsitem.title: USA: FedEx launches next-day shipping from Asia.
newsitem.headline: FedEx launches next-day shipping from Asia.

text.p: Federal Express Corp said Wednesday it is introducing a direct flight from Osaka, Japan that will provide the only next-business-day shipping from major Asian markets to North America.
The flights, which originate in Singapore, go from Osaka to Memphis. They should begin September 1 and cut transit times across the Pacific in half for customers, Federal Express said.
The company said it is offering delivery for 10:30 a.m. the next day, backed by a money-back guarantee.
Federal Express said the routing will let it provide pickups one to three hours later in the day for customers in key Asian markets such as Singapore, Taipei, Hiroshima, Kuala Lumpur and Penang.
